method.append_api_latency: starts immediately before append_results and ends on return, including sync; record preparation outside call timing
method.cache: read is warm after writes, no cold-cache claim
method.durability: uses production sync_all; not proof of device power-loss behavior
method.maintenance: only explicit maintenance phase; append may include automatic compaction if necessary
method.payload_bandwidth: raw delivery bytes only, excludes frame/JSON metadata and filesystem write amplification
method.teardown: journal drop and owned-directory cleanup occur outside reported stage timings; external /usr/bin/time includes them
method.wall_throughput: includes driver allocation and validation within that stage, excludes initialization/setup for read/metadata/state stages

profile: release expected; runner must record build command

stages.cache_state: warm OS page cache after append; no cache purge or cold-device claim
stages.percentile_method: nearest-rank, ceil(p*N/100), measured per API call; not per-record percentiles
